Authentication.description:
Represents a standalone authentication method or "form". This object serves as a mechanism to logically group fields required for authentication.
For example: a device may require an access token to communicate over the LAN. The integration may also support communicating via a cloud api, requiring a clientId and clientSecret.
In this case, the integration would return two Authentication objects, one for the LAN method and one for the cloud method, each with their respective fields and types.

fields.description: A list of authentication fields required for this authentication method. Each field has a type that indicates how the value should be obtained or set.

id.description: The unique identifier for this authentication method. This is used when setting authentication values.

label.description:
A short description of the authentication method. For example: "Local Network Authentication", "Cloud Authentication", etc...
This will be displayed to the user.

valid.description:
Reports the state of this authentication method. If false, one or more of the fields are missing or invalid.
There is no way to report the validity of an individual field within the authentication method itself.

AuthenticationField.description: Represents a single field within an authentication method.

credentialType.description:
The credential type that best describes the kind
of value stored in value.

key.description: The unique identifier for this authentication field.

label.description: A short, user-facing label describing this field. For example: "Password", "Access Token", etc...

type.description:
The type of this authentication field, indicating how the value should be obtained or set.
Pay close attention any specific requirements or constraints for the type being used.
- "STRING": An authentication field of type string. For example: a password, pin, preshared-key, access token, etc...

- "PROMPT": Prompt triggers an out-of-band authentication flow. For example: displaying a prompt on the device requesting permissions,
or having a user scan a QR code. There is a 30 second timeout for a prompt to resolve.

If an authentication method's fields list contains a field of type `PROMPT`, it must be the only field present in the list.

value.description:
The current value of this authentication field. This typically only applies for the STRING types, but
may be populated for other authentication types as well.

AuthenticationFieldInput.description: Input type for setting the value of a single authentication field.

key.description: The unique identifier of the authentication field to set.

value.description: The value to set for this authentication field.

AuthenticationInput.description:
Input type for setting authentication values on an authentication method.
This is only applicable for authentication methods composed of STRING fields.

fields.description: The list of field values to set for this authentication method.

id.description: The unique identifier of the authentication method to set values for.

DispatchPowerReboot.description:
Dispatch a device reboot. The integration should NOT wait until the reboot has completed.
The resulting boolean reflects whether the reboot was dispatched.

updateStatus.description:
The current status of any ongoing firmware update operation.
- "UNSUPPORTED": Indicates that the integration does not support monitoring firmware update status, or that it cannot determine the current status of a firmware update operation.
This DOES NOT indicate that the integration does not support firmware updates at all. See the `updateCandidates` field on the firmware type for that information.

- "READY": Communicates that the device is ready to begin a firmware update, and supports monitoring the status of the update once it has begun.
This does not indicate that a firmware update is available. See the `updateCandidates` field on the firmware type for that information.

- "COMPLETE": Indicates that the firmware update has completed successfully.

- "INPROGRESS": Indicates that a firmware update is currently in progress.

- "FAILED": Indicates that the firmware update has failed.

current.description: The current firmware version details for the device.

updateCandidates.description:
A list of firmware versions available for update.
A non-empty list indicates that a firmware update is available and that this integration supports dispatching firmware updates.

A null value indicates that the integration does not support firmware updates, or that it cannot determine if there are any updates available.
An empty list indicates that there are no firmware updates currently available for this device, but that the integration does support firmware updates.

FirmwareVersionDetails.description: An object describing an available firmware version for the device.

documentationUrl.description: A url pointing to documentation for this firmware version. This is used for display purposes in the UI when listing available firmware versions, and can be used by the user to learn more about this firmware version before deciding to update.

friendlyName.description: A user-friendly name for this firmware version. This is used for display purposes in the UI when listing available firmware versions.

id.description: A unique identifier for this firmware version. This is used when dispatching a firmware update to specify which version to update to.

releaseDate.description: The date this firmware version was released.

releaseNotes.description: A description of the changes included in this firmware version. This is used for display purposes in the UI when listing available firmware versions.

size.description: The size of the firmware file in bytes.

GetAuthentication.description: Authentication methods supported by the integration.

GetFirmware.description: Firmware metadata reported by the camera.

GetImageSettings.description: Lens/source image settings exposed by the camera.

GetMetadata.description: Integration metadata reported by the camera.

GetNetwork.description: Network information reported by the camera.

GetPower.description: Power capabilities and state reported by the camera.

GetProfiles.description: Video streaming profiles exposed by the camera.

GetSystem.description: System-level metadata reported by the camera.

IPv4Config.description: The IPv4 configuration for a network interface, including the assigned address, netmask, gateway, and dns servers.

address.description:
The IPv4 address assigned to the device.
This may be null if the device does not expose this information.

dnsServers.description:
A list of dns servers assigned to the device.
The list must return at most 3 servers.

gateway.description: The IPv4 gateway assigned to the device.

netmask.description: The IPv4 netmask assigned to the device.

IPv4Settings.description: IPv4 network settings for a network interface, including the effective configuration, static configuration, and supported address types.

addressType.description:
The currently active address type for this network interface.
- "DHCP": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are obtained via DHCP.

- "DHCP_STATIC_DNS": DHCP address, netmask, and gateway, with static DNS.

- "STATIC": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are statically configured.

- "STATIC_DHCP_DNS": Static address, netmask, and gateway, with DNS obtained via DHCP.

addressTypes.description:
A list of supported address types for this network interface,
which can be changed if canSet is true.

items.description:
- "DHCP": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are obtained via DHCP.

- "DHCP_STATIC_DNS": DHCP address, netmask, and gateway, with static DNS.

- "STATIC": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are statically configured.

- "STATIC_DHCP_DNS": Static address, netmask, and gateway, with DNS obtained via DHCP.

canSet.description:
Whether this interface's IPv4 configuration can be changed right now, given the 
device's current state. Independent of enabled and canEnable on the interface.

dnsServerCount.description:
The number of dns servers the network interface supports.
This value may be at most 3.

effective.description: The configuration currently in effect on this network interface.

static.description: Where applicable, the static IPv4 configuration for this network interface.

IPv4StaticConfigInput.description: The configuration for a given static network interface.

address.description: IPv4 address configuration for this network interface.

ImageSettings.description: Image settings exposed by the camera across physical sources/lenses.

sources.description: A list of physical sources on the camera.

ImageSettingsSource.description: Represents a single physical source (or lens) on the camera.

configuredDayNightMode.description:
The currently configured day/night mode for this lens.
- "DAY": Day mode.

- "NIGHT": Night mode.

- "AUTO": Automatically switch between day and night mode based on the current lighting conditions.

currentDayNightMode.description:
The current day/night mode for this lens. This value may be different
than the configuredDayNightMode if the configuredDayNightMode is set
to AUTO and the camera has automatically switched modes based on lighting
conditions. Must not be set to AUTO, as AUTO is only a valid value for
configuredDayNightMode.
- "DAY": Day mode.

- "NIGHT": Night mode.

- "AUTO": Automatically switch between day and night mode based on the current lighting conditions.

id.description: The id of the physical source on the camera.

rotation.description: The clockwise rotation currently applied to the image, in degrees.

rotationMode.description:
The rotation mode currently applied to the image.
- "FIXED": The image is rotated by a fixed angle.

- "AUTO": The camera chooses the rotation automatically.

IntegrationAuthentication.description: The container for all authentication items.

methods.description:
A list of authentication methods required or
available for a user to use.

interfaces.description: A list of available network interfaces on the device, such as Wi-Fi adapters and Ethernet ports.

NetworkConfigInput.description: Updates to apply to the device's network configuration.

interfaces.description: The interfaces to update, with their configuration.

addressType.description:
The address type to use for the network interface.
- "DHCP": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are obtained via DHCP.

- "DHCP_STATIC_DNS": DHCP address, netmask, and gateway, with static DNS.

- "STATIC": Address, netmask, gateway, and DNS are statically configured.

- "STATIC_DHCP_DNS": Static address, netmask, and gateway, with DNS obtained via DHCP.

NetworkInterface.description: A network interface on the device, such as a Wi-Fi adapter or Ethernet port.

adapterType.description:
The adapter type of this interface.
If the value of this field is "UNKNOWN",
but wifi is non-null, "WIRELESS" will be inferred as the type.

A null value is equivalent to "UNKNOWN".
- "UNKNOWN": 

- "WIRED": 

- "WIRELESS":

canEnable.description:
Whether this network interface can be enabled via the integration.
Null indicates the integration does not support changing the enabled status of
any network interfaces. False indicates the network interface cannot be enabled,
but the integration does support changing the enabled status of network interfaces
where canEnable is true.

enabled.description: Whether this network interface is currently enabled.

friendlyName.description: A user-friendly name for this network interface, such as "Wi-Fi", "Ethernet", "eth0", etc...

id.description: A unique identifier for this network interface. This is used when setting network configuration, if supported.

ipv4.description: The IPv4 settings for this network interface.

wifi.description:
Details about the Wi-Fi connection for this network interface.
If this value is null, it is assumed that the network interface is a wired connection.

NetworkInterfaceConfigInput.description: Used when updating the network interface configuration for a device.

enabled.description:
Whether to enable or disable this network interface.
This value is only relevant when the network interface canEnable field is non-null.
A null value in this field should be treated as "no change" to the enabled status of the network interface.

id.description: The unique identifier of the network interface to update the configuration for.

ipv4.description: The configuration for the network interface's IPv4 settings. If null, the IPv4 configuration should not be changed.

Power.description: Power capabilities reported by the camera.

canReboot.description: Indicates whether the camera supports a reboot action.

friendlyName.description:
A user-facing name for this streaming profile, used to identify
the profile in source-selection interfaces. Must not be empty.

id.description: A unique stable identifier for this profile.

video.description: Configured encoding settings for the video stream.

Profiles.description: Streaming profile configuration exposed by the camera.

available.description: A list of configured streaming profiles on the camera.

code.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error code. Codes in the range -32768 to -32000 are reserved for pre-defined errors.

result.description: The method result. Type is defined by the specific method.

Resolution.description: Represents a video resolution in pixels.

height.description:
Number of pixels across the y-axis of the video image, prior to taking rotation into account.
For example, a 1080p video rotated to 90 degrees would have a height of 1080.
A 1080p video rotated to 0 degrees would have a height of 1080.

width.description:
Number of pixels across the x-axis of the video image, prior to taking rotation into account.
For example, a 1080p video rotated to 90 degrees would have a width of 1920.
A 1080p video rotated to 0 degrees would have a width of 1920.

canSetEnabled.description:
Whether SDDP can be enabled or disabled right now.
Null indicates the integration does not support enabling or disabling SDDP.

canSetCredentials.description:
Whether communities and v3 users can be changed right now.
Null indicates the integration does not support setting SNMP credentials.

canSetEnabled.description:
Whether SNMP can be enabled or disabled right now.
Null indicates the integration does not support enabling or disabling SNMP.

enabled.description:
Whether the SNMP agent is enabled.
Null if the device has no global toggle; see v2.enabled and v3.enabled.

v2.description: SNMPv1/v2c settings. Null if the device does not support v1/v2c.

v3.description: SNMPv3 settings. Null if the device does not support v3.

SNMPCredential.description: A secret value, such as a community string or passphrase.

value.description: Null if the device does not expose the value.

SNMPCredentials.description: SNMP secrets. Served live from the device, never cached.

v2ReadCommunity.description: Null if read-only v1/v2c access is not configured.

v2WriteCommunity.description: Null if read-write v1/v2c access is not configured.

v3ReadUser.description: Null if the v3 read-only user is not configured.

v3WriteUser.description: Null if the v3 read-write user is not configured.

v2.description: Null leaves the v1/v2c communities unchanged.

v3.description: Null leaves the v3 users unchanged.

readAccess.description: Whether a read-only community is configured.

writeAccess.description: Whether a read-write community is configured.

authProtocols.description: The authentication protocols this device supports.

privProtocols.description: The privacy protocols this device supports.

readUser.description: The user granted read-only access. Null if not configured.

writeUser.description: The user granted read-write access. Null if not configured.

privProtocol.description:
Null indicates no encryption. Requires authProtocol.
- "DES": 

- "TRIPLE_DES": 

- "AES128": 

- "AES192": 

- "AES256":

authPassphrase.description:
Null keeps the current value.
Required when authProtocol changes or the user is new.

privPassphrase.description:
Null keeps the current value.
Required when privProtocol changes or the user is new.

System.description: System metadata reported by the camera.

contactInformation.description: The name, email or both of who to contact about the device.

dateTime.description: Date/time metadata reported by the camera.

hostname.description: Hostname reported directly by the camera.

serialNumber.description: Serial number reported by the camera.

SystemDateTime.description: Date/time metadata reported by the camera.

daylightSavingsEnabled.description:
Reports whether daylight saving time (DST) is enabled on the camera.
If false, the camera-reported date/time will not apply daylight saving adjustments.

localDateTime.description: An RFC 3339 compliant date-time reflecting the camera's local time and timezone.

source.description:
Reports how the camera obtains the current date/time.
- "MANUAL": Date/time is manually configured.

- "NTP": Date/time is synchronized via NTP.

VideoEncoding.description: Video encoding settings for a streaming profile.

codec.description:
A user-friendly representation of the current video encoding codec.
Examples might include: {id:"h265", friendlyName:"H.265"}, {id:"mpeg4", friendlyName:"MPEG4"}, etc.

maxBitrate.description:
The ceiling bitrate the camera is currently
configured to use in Kbps.

maxFrameRate.description: The maximum frame rate the camera is currently configured to use in frames per second.

ssid.description: The SSID of the currently connected Wi-Fi network, if applicable.
